title: 돌아갈 곳
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with soft rock influences. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and delay. A sub-heavy kick drum and subtle electronic percussion provide a steady pulse. The bass guitar enters with melodic slides and sustained notes. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate tenor, transitioning to a powerful, belted chest voice in the chorus. Strings enter during the chorus with sustained legato pads. The track is in the key of E Major at 72 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggio with chorus effect]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
새벽 공기 가득 [sub-kick enters]
배낭 하나 메고서
출구 쪽 유리 너머
활주로 불빛이 떠
엔진 소리 울려와
발밑이 진동해 [bass guitar enters with a slide]
떠나본 적 없잖아 그래서 무서워
근데 웃기게도 돌아갈 곳이 있어

[Chorus]
[full band enters, strings swell, belted vocals]
돌아갈 곳이 있으니까
